strategies.name: Baseline sequential all-reduce chain
strategies.desc: Eight sequential all_reduce operations with interleaved local scaling and division operations, exactly as in the reference implementation. Requires 8 all_reduce dispatches with full vector payload (W*S elements) each time. Represents the straightforward approach with no optimization—high dispatch count but simple correctness guarantee.

strategies.name: Fused local operations per stage
strategies.desc: Still 8 all_reduce operations but fuse all local element-wise operations (scaling by a[r]/W and division by a[r]) into single vectorized kernels per stage instead of explicit loops over ranks. Reduces local compute dispatches from ~8*W scalar operations to 8 fused vector operations, keeping 8 collective dispatches but hiding local overhead in bulk tensor ops.

strategies.name: Precompute scaling coefficients with batched application
strategies.desc: Precompute the compound scaling factor applied across all 8 stages (a[r]/W then /a[r], repeated 7 times), recognize the pattern simplifies algebraically, then apply batched scaling. The 8-stage chain still requires 8 all_reduce calls due to dependencies, but local work collapses to initial setup and final application, reducing dispatch overhead for local operations.

strategies.name: Split-buffer double-buffering for computation overlap
strategies.desc: Allocate two buffers and alternate between them across the 8 stages, allowing potential compiler/runtime pipelining of the next stage's local preparation while current all_reduce executes. Still 8 all_reduce dispatches but interleaves compute and communication by structuring buffer usage to expose parallelism opportunities, trading memory (2x buffer) for latency hiding.

strategies.name: Hierarchical reduce-scatter then all-gather pattern
strategies.desc:
Recognize that each all_reduce is sum across all ranks; replace with reduce-scatter (producing W chunks distributed) followed by local scaling on owned chunk, then all-gather. Transforms each all_reduce+local-scale stage into reduce-scatter + local-op + all-gather, totaling 8*2=16 collectives but with smaller per-rank payloads (S instead of W*S), potentially faster on bandwidth-constrained interconnect.
